assessments.reasoning: Section 3.3 permits a block comment in the recursive sequence forming a block comment and requires matching delimiters.

challenge.method: Apply the delimiters to a nested pair, remove the outer closing delimiter, and compare both strings with the separate line-ending rule.
challenge.results: The nested delimiters give depths 1, 2, 1, 0. Omitting the final delimiter leaves depth 1, so it is not the same valid block-comment example. A line-ending comment terminates at a line break or program end.

limitations: This checks the draft syntax of a properly delimited nested block. It makes no claim about scanner implementation techniques.
